_note: Copy and tiers of /pricing (app/pricing/page.tsx, components/pricing/*). PRICES: each tier's `from` is null until the owner fills it in. null shows 'Fixed price / after a 30-minute call'; a plain number (e.g. 4500, no currency sign, no dots or commas) shows 'From €4,500 / one-time'. `badge` (null or a short label such as 'Most common') puts a label on one card; only set it when it is true. Only true claims: one-time payment, full codebase handed over, unlimited orders and products, priced by connections, built on the existing engine. The real client stays anonymous and is told generically: no product-category words and no marketplace or warehouse brand names or logos on this page (the live demo may show them). Never name or compare with another vendor.

items.title: A one-time payment
items.body: You pay once for the build. No monthly subscription for the software, and no fee per order or per product.

items.title: Priced by connections
items.body: A connection is one platform or account we connect: a marketplace account, a web store, your warehouse system. The price follows how many there are.

items.title: Built on our engine
items.body: The engine is already built. We shape your version on your requirements, so you pay for your setup, not for the basics, and never for extras.

items.q: Are there limits on orders or products?
items.a: No. There is no fee per order or per product. The price is set by the connections, not by how much you sell or how big your catalogue is.

items.q: Can we add a connection later?
items.a: Yes. We quote it the same way: a fixed price for the extra connection, agreed before we start.

items.q: How long does a build take?
items.a: It depends on the connections. We tell you the time together with the fixed price, after the call.
